r: Config command allows you to change configuration of service or host.

<dl><dt data-c="">nm_enable</dt><dd>Config network manager to use dnsconfd</dd><dt data-c="">nm_disable</dt><dd>Config network manager to not use dnsconfd</dd><dt data-c="">take_resolvconf</dt><dd>Change ownership of resolv conf, so dnsconfd does not need root privileges</dd><dt data-c="">return_resolvconf</dt><dd>Return ownership of resolv conf, so root is again the owner</dd><dt data-c="">install</dt><dd>Perform all installation steps</dd><dt data-c="">uninstall</dt><dd>Perform all uninstallation steps</dd></dl>

Environment variables have lower priority than command line options but higher than configuration file.

DBUS_NAME
DBUS name that dnsconfd should use, default org.freedesktop.resolve1
LOG_LEVEL
Log level of dnsconfd, default INFO
CONFIG_FILE
Path where config file is located, default /etc/dnsconfd.conf
Please for reporting bugs use Github repository https://github.com/InfrastructureServices/dnsconfd

dnsconfd(8) Dnsconfd daemon dnsconfd-reload(8) Reload running cache service dnsconfd-status(8) Check status of dnsconfd dnsconfd-update(8) Change Dnsconfd configuration dnsconfd.conf(5) Dnsconfd configuration file
